snippet.title: Fool King - Game Overview (New Strategy Autobattler)
snippet.description:
Join the Loot Donkey devs, Ben and Gareth (Spudonkey), as they take you through Fool King, their upcoming autobattler where your goal is to dethrone the reigning Fool King and eventually become the final boss for everyone else. 👑⚔️

Build powerful armies, recruit unique units and call on the Gods to shape your strategy. Then battle against opponents created by players from around the world. Every run is different, every build is unique and every defeat helps unlock new units, Gods, cosmetics and strategies for your next run.

If you enjoy autobattlers, roguelikes, strategy games or medieval fantasy worlds, we'd love your support. 

Wishlist Fool King on Steam and subscribe to follow development and be the first to know when Demo 1 goes live as Loot Donkey heads towards Early Access. 

Wishlist the game today - https://store.steampowered.com/app/4380860/

Join LootDonkey on Discord - https://discord.com/invite/GngG8PfNw4

Find out more about WuselFaktory Publishing - http://wuselfaktory.com/
